clues.body: This is a medical record, or perhaps a learning record. It documents part of the AI's learning process. Strange: even such a powerful AI needs to learn. What does it need to learn? Through this prop, I can see the truth.

clues.body: Since its creation, the AI has continued to improve and innovate. Yet its understanding and imitation of human nature have never been sufficient. To solve this, the AI sought help from the world's leading psychologist, trying to understand the human mind and make better choices and judgments.
